name: Blah Blah Family
detailed_description:
A weird, funny, and slightly suspicious adventure.
You're visiting your girlfriend’s family for the first time. She’s lovely. Her family? A little... unconventional. But hey, you're just here to be polite, help out, and enjoy a quiet weekend in the countryside.

You’ll spend time with her relatives, take on a few simple tasks, and explore the house and surrounding areas at your own pace. Everything seems fine... if a little odd, but nothing you can’t brush off with a smile and a bit of patience.

And sure, if you start to get the strange feeling that something’s off or that the family might have... other intentions, well, that’s probably just your imagination. After all, they’ve never done anything wrong to any of the other boyfriends!

As you journey through the game, you'll interact with environments and characters, discovering the family’s peaceful routines while engaging in casual activities with your girlfriend. Little by little, you’ll find yourself questioning the seemingly ordinary moments and the people around you, all while making choices that shape how things unfold.

Everything will feel smooth and carefree, with you and your girlfriend enjoying a simple, fun weekend together. The family will be warm and welcoming... At least, that’s what you tell yourself on your way to the house!

Key Features:

  •  A narrative-driven experience full of offbeat charm

  •  Delightfully weird characters with questionable social norms

  •  Light exploration and surreal situations

  •  A dry mix of humour, tension, and "wait, did that really happen?" moments

  •  A one-way trip into polite discomfort

short_description: Visiting your girlfriend’s happy family for the first time. Enjoy completely normal activities together. Sure, things might feel a bit off, but hey, it’s just your imagination! As a wise man once said: "Blah, blah blah blah!" That probably means "trust the weird random family!"
